## How to use
1. Pick the **MODE** switch (orange node): **OFF = TEXT→PANO** (Krea 2 generates the pano from the scene prompt) · **ON = IMAGE→PANO** (your photo is converted to a 360 pano by Qwen-Edit + the 360 LoRA).
2. Always describe the scene in the green **SCENE PROMPT** — in image mode it drives the Krea refine + seam fix, so describe *your photo*.
3. Queue. The result lands in `output/SplatKit/` and feeds straight into SplatKit workflow `1_camera_plot_flythrough`.

**Qwen Image Edit 2511** (image→pano mode) → 📁 `diffusion_models/qwen`
- [qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI/tree/main/split_files/diffusion_models)

**Text encoder**: [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) (type `qwen_image`) · **VAE**: [qwen_image_vae](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors)

**LoRAs** → 📁 `loras/qwen`: [Lightning 4-step 2511](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning) + **251018_MICKMUMPITZ_QWEN-EDIT_360_03** (own trained 360 LoRA)

## Why 3 passes?
- **Qwen 360 LoRA** nails the equirect *geometry* but is soft on detail.
- **KREA REFINE** (denoise ≈0.35) re-details every pixel without moving the geometry — this is what makes the pano look Krea-quality.
- **SEAM FIX** rolls the pano 180°, inpaints the wrap seam strip, rolls back → left/right edges match perfectly (important for SplatKit).
